title: Daniel G
content: I was in complete blackness and could not see anything. It felt like I was floating in nothingness. A couch appeared with what looked like bedside tables on each side; followed by a massive screen in front of it. I could sense two entities behind me. I wasn't worried or fearful of them, although I couldn't see them. I could feel a sense of calm surrounded them. As I sat down on the couch, images and videos of my childhood began playing. It was a very pleasant feeling. The images soon changed to my then-current relationship. The theme was showing how I was mistreated by getting hit or kicked, and then cheating on me. I felt very sad and upset at seeing this. At that moment, the entity to my right placed what I could only describe as its hand on my shoulder. The sadness slowly went away. I came to in my recovery bed. I could only remember snippets and images. The memories were very blurry, but I was changed a little. I didn't really want anyone visiting me in the hospital, except my mum and dad. I was feeling stronger somehow.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Surgery-related, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, Hard to explain. I somehow know that the pain I'm experiencing is for some reason.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was upset and the entity put their hand on my shoulder.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Very strange. It was like watching my childhood, followed by all the bad in my then relationship playing out in sequence, but also seeming to play all at the same time.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Extremely focused. Everything around me blacked out except for the couch I was on and the screen in front of me.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: My hearing was muffled. It was more about what I was feeling and seeing than hearing.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place, There was complete darkness all around me; with no floor, ceiling, or walls. But there was a couch and what looked like bedside tables on each side with a giant screen in front of the couch.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt pain and sadness, followed by peace and strength.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt no longer in conflict with nature
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others, Became more aware of my inner thoughts and feelings. How I was being changed by those around me. I am stronger than that.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: I saw videos and snippets of my life as a young child. Then I saw all the bad things that I put up with in my then relationship, such as the cheating and verbal abuse. All were true and I found out even more after I left the relationship.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Do not know, No religious background at all. I went to Sunday school when I was young, but never had any religion pushed on me whatsoever.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain, I'm more aware. I believe in the universe and that one day I will return. I believe in soul growth moments. That challenges in our lives are there for a reason.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths, I believe we are all part of this universe, experiencing a human life before going home.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I had always entertained the idea of something greater in the universe than just us on Earth. But having non-human entities by my side and feeling an immense sense of calm and peace was a feeling I had never experienced before.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I don't like the term "god" as it sounds singular. I believe we are all part of this universe and one day will return to where we came from.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, There were two entities out of sight, but they were behind me. They were gentle and caring.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, There must be an existence outside our earthly realm. There were two entities behind me who seemed surrounded in a sense of calmness. It wasn't like anything here on earth.
Yes, Yes. My own difficulties and hardships that I put up with for so long. Videos played back of all the times that I was put down, cheated on, and verbally abused.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I stood up for myself and righted the wrongs done to me. I feel stronger as a person and speak my mind instead of holding it in.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I left a toxic partner and found my true soul mate.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, Really hard to explain, but I only really told one very close friend (now my wife) and the more I talked about it, the clearer my memories of the event became.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I was worried that it was just a dream. But the more I talked to a close friend about it, the more I remembered and the more detail I also recalled.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain, I can sense if someone is a good or bad person. I know which people to stay clear of.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Seeing the bad I put up with, feeling those feelings, and knowing that will never happen again.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain, I watched a few documentaries on the subject. I never really gave it much thought.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real, I wondered if it was a dream or if it did happen.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, Talking about it to my now wife over and over again, I know it was real. I feel it was real.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, The questions brought out emotional responses and helped bring the memories into words.
